title: Contract Growth Multiplier on Restart Change Order Fees — Professional Services Projects
content:
Growth of a Professional Services Projects contract through signed change orders scales the administration fee of a restart change order.

## Clause

Where the growth is the value changes of every change order the client has signed, this one included, which is the contract value less the original value, as a percent of the original value, the administration fee of a restart change order is multiplied by 1.25 for a growth of 20 percent or more, by 1.1 for 5 percent or more but below 20 percent, and left unchanged for any smaller growth.

| Growth as a percent of the original value | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 1.25 |
| 5 or more, below 20 | 1.1 |
| below 5 | unchanged |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures, original value 100000.00)

- Signed value changes of 8000.00 and 4000.00, the restart change order included: growth 12 percent, multiplier 1.1.
- Signed value changes adding to 20000.00: growth 20 percent, multiplier 1.25.
- A signed scope addition of 6000.00 and a signed scope reduction of 3000.00: the value changes add to 3000.00, growth 3 percent, unchanged.
